title: StrategyPackage manifest schema still binds platform runtime policies instead of alpha core only
description:
Expected: StrategyPackage frozen manifest should bind only factor/model alpha core: factor set/order/schema, model spec/weights/training evidence, source lineage, and artifact hashes. Daily strategy, portfolio top_k, universe/ST PIT, minute execution, tail handling, risk/event/HMM, broker, account, and approval state should live in platform runtime profile, validated execution policy, release/binding version, or activation records. Old docs must be superseded by docs/architecture/strategy_package_platform_boundary_contract_20260520.md.
Actual: backend/services/strategy_package/models.py still requires strategy_config, universe_policy, portfolio_policy, execution_policy, minute_execution_policy, and risk_policy in StrategyPackageManifest. backend/services/strategy_package/qe_source_resolver.py still copies QE custom_params, stock_pool, topk/n_drop, execution/backtest frequency, and minute_execution_policy into the frozen manifest. This keeps platform runtime decisions inside the StrategyPackage boundary and causes later Selection/Paper/MiniQMT paths to treat package metadata as executable runtime authority.
required_verification: New or migrated StrategyPackage contract tests prove platform runtime policies are not required fields for the alpha-core manifest.
QE source resolution persists daily/execution/HMM/ST PIT/risk context as source evidence or platform release references, not frozen manifest authority.
Selection/Paper/MiniQMT tests use platform profile/policy references for runtime behavior while preserving package alpha-core immutability.
closure_requirements: StrategyPackage alpha-core manifest no longer expands platform runtime policy fields for new development.
Legacy manifest v1 remains marked legacy and does not drive new platform runtime behavior.
All affected code paths either consume a PackageRuntimeRelease/platform profile or fail fast with a migration-required error.
